comment: E’s deeper plain ReLU bundle beat B’s residual LeakyReLU bundle despite equal LN counts and identical SGD settings. I overcredited residual optimization; K1039 supported rectifiers over smooth activations, not B over E. K1006 correctly warned against topology scoring. Better nonlinear feature refinement through E’s normalized plain stack is plausible, but unmeasured; depth, width, activation and LN placement remain confounded. Backtesting found one comparable historical pair: plain won (1 hit, 0 misses). Exact deep, ≥3-LN lab comparisons numbered zero. Broader normalized-rectifier SGD comparisons favored deeper plain univariate models in 13/16 pairs across eight sets, but only 2/6 multivariate pairs. These dependent, mismatched comparisons do not establish a reliable E-over-B rule.
